headline: Policy changes on employee computer use, restraint and seclusion, and a $7,000 backpack gift.
summary: Consent items include a transfer of funds from contingency to pay legal fees for an FOI complaint. The agenda also covers course deletions, policy and regulation updates, and certified staff retirements and leaves.

Adopt or revise Policy 4118.5/4218.5, employee use of district computer systems and electronic communications
